questions.question: In a team of 75 employees, the average monthly sales per employee is ₹ 1.8 lakh. If 30 junior employees average ₹ 1.2 lakh each, what is the average monthly sales figure (in ₹ lakh) for the senior employees?
questions.questionHtml: In a team of 75 employees, the average monthly sales per employee is ₹ 1.8 lakh. If 30 junior employees average ₹ 1.2 lakh each, what is the average monthly sales figure (in ₹ lakh) for the senior employees?
questions.solution:
Total sales of the team ⇒ 75 × 1.8 = ₹135 lakh.

Total sales of junior employees ⇒ 30 × 1.2 = ₹36 lakh.

Total sales of senior employees ⇒ ₹135 − ₹36 = ₹99 lakh; Average sales ⇒ ₹99 ÷ 45 = ₹2.2 lakh.

questions.question: A company placed an order for 20 high-end laptops and some quantity of standard desktops. The price of a high-end laptop was 5 times that of a standard desktop. Due to a mistake, the number of laptops and desktops was interchanged in the delivery. This caused the total bill to increase by 80%. What was the ratio of the number of high-end laptops to standard desktops in the original order?
questions.questionHtml: A company placed an order for 20 high-end laptops and some quantity of standard desktops. The price of a high-end laptop was 5 times that of a standard desktop. Due to a mistake, the number of laptops and desktops was interchanged in the delivery. This caused the total bill to increase by 80%. What was the ratio of the number of high-end laptops to standard desktops in the original order?
questions.solution:
Let number of desktops = x and price of 1 desktop = ₹p.

Original bill = (20 × 5p) + (x × p); Wrong bill = (x × 5p) + (20 × p); Wrong bill = 1.8 × Original bill.

⇒ 5px + 20p = 1.8 × (100p + xp); ⇒ 5x + 20 = 180 + 1.8x.

⇒ 5x − 1.8x = 180 − 20; ⇒ 3.2x = 160; ⇒ x = 50.

Ratio of laptops : desktops = 20 : 50 = 2 : 5.

questions.question: The price of petrol shot up by 5%. Before the hike, the price was Rs. 82 per litre. A man travels 3045 km every month and his car gives a mileage of 15 km per litre. What is the increase in the monthly expenditure (to the nearest Rs.) on the man's travel due to the hike in the petrol prices?
questions.questionHtml: The price of petrol shot up by 5%. Before the hike, the price was Rs. 82 per litre. A man travels 3045 km every month and his car gives a mileage of 15 km per litre. What is the increase in the monthly expenditure (to the nearest Rs.) on the man's travel due to the hike in the petrol prices?
questions.solution:
⇒ New price = 82 + (82 × 5 ÷ 100) = 82 + 4.1 = ₹86.1/litre

⇒ Petrol required = 3045 ÷ 15 = 203 litres

⇒ Increase in expenditure = 203 × (86.1 − 82) = 203 × 4.1 = ₹832.3

⇒ Nearest rupee = ₹832

questions.question: Find the compound interest on ₹8,000 at 12% per annum for 3 years 4 months, compounded annually.
questions.questionHtml: Find the compound interest on ₹8,000 at 12% per annum for 3 years 4 months, compounded annually.
questions.solution:
Let Principal (P) = ₹8,000, Rate (R) = 12% per annum, Time (T) = 3 years 4 months = 31/3 years.

⇒ Amount (A) for 3 years = 8000 × (1 + 12/100)3 = 8000 × (1.12)3 = 8000 × 1.404928 = ₹11,239.42.

⇒ Simple Interest for next 4 months = 11,239.42 × 12 × (1/3) ÷ 100 = ₹449.58.

⇒ Final Amount = 11,239.42 + 449.58 = ₹11,689.00.

⇒ Compound Interest (CI) = 11,689.00 − 8,000 = ₹3,689.00.

questions.question: A, B, and C are capable of completing a job in 30, 45, and 90 days, respectively. A works every day, while B and C join A every fifth day. How long will it take to finish the task?
questions.questionHtml: A, B, and C are capable of completing a job in 30, 45, and 90 days, respectively. A works every day, while B and C join A every fifth day. How long will it take to finish the task?
questions.solution:
LCM of 30, 45, 90 = 90 units (Total work).

A's 1 day work = 90 ÷ 30 = 3 units, B's 1 day work = 90 ÷ 45 = 2 units, C's 1 day work = 90 ÷ 90 = 1 unit.

A works 4 days alone = 4 × 3 = 12 units; On 5th day, A + B + C work together = 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 units.

Work done in 5 days = 12 + 6 = 18 units; Total work in 25 days (5 cycles) = 5 × 18 = 90 units.

∴ Total time = 25 days.

questions.question: A car starts from point P on a circular track and an SUV starts from point Q, which is 600 meters ahead of P in the direction of motion. The car's speed is 15 m/s, and the SUV's speed is 10 m/s. The circumference of the track is 1.5 km. How much distance will the car have traveled when it first overtakes the SUV?
questions.questionHtml: A car starts from point P on a circular track and an SUV starts from point Q, which is 600 meters ahead of P in the direction of motion. The car's speed is 15 m/s, and the SUV's speed is 10 m/s. The circumference of the track is 1.5 km. How much distance will the car have traveled when it first overtakes the SUV?
questions.solution:
Relative speed = 15 − 10 = 5 m/s

Time to overtake = 600 ÷ 5 = 120 seconds

Distance traveled by the car = 15 × 120 = 1800 m

questions.question: The ratio of the efficiencies of two workers, P and Q, is 5 : 2. If P can complete a project in 12 days, how many days will Q take to complete the same project alone?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of the efficiencies of two workers, P and Q, is 5 : 2. If P can complete a project in 12 days, how many days will Q take to complete the same project alone?
questions.solution:
Efficiency of P = 5, Efficiency of Q = 2

Total work = 5 × 12 = 60 units

Q's time = Total work ÷ Q's efficiency ⇒ 60 ÷ 2 = 30 days

questions.question: The line y = -x + 4 passes through which of the following points?
questions.questionHtml: The line y = -x + 4 passes through which of the following points?
questions.solution:
Substitute (2, 2) into y = −x + 4:

⇒ 2 = −(2) + 4

⇒ 2 = 2 (True)

Substitute (5, 4) into y = −x + 4:

⇒ 4 = −(5) + 4

⇒ 4 = −1 (False)

Substitute (1, 2) into y = −x + 4:

⇒ 2 = −(1) + 4

⇒ 2 = 3 (False)

Substitute (3, 6) into y = −x + 4:

⇒ 6 = −(3) + 4

⇒ 6 = 1 (False)

Correct point: (2, 2).

questions.question: A circular park having a radius of 14 m. If a 1.5 m wide path is built around it, what is the approximate area of the path?
questions.questionHtml: A circular park having a radius of 14 m. If a 1.5 m wide path is built around it, what is the approximate area of the path?
questions.solution:
Radius of the outer circle = 14 + 1.5 = 15.5 m

Area of the inner circle = π × 142 = (22/7) × 14 × 14 = 616 m2

Area of the outer circle = π × 15.52 = (22/7) × 15.5 × 15.5 = 754.38 m2

Area of the path = 754.38 − 616 = 138.38 m2 ≈ 139 m2

questions.question: What is the central angle of a sector with an arc length of 10 cm in a circle of radius 5 cm?
questions.questionHtml: What is the central angle of a sector with an arc length of 10 cm in a circle of radius 5 cm?
questions.solution:
Central angle = Arc length ÷ Radius

⇒ Central angle = 10 ÷ 5

⇒ Central angle = 2 radians

questions.question: The angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are in the ratio 1:2:3:4. What is the measure of the smallest angle?
questions.questionHtml: The angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are in the ratio 1:2:3:4. What is the measure of the smallest angle?
questions.solution:
Let the angles of the quadrilateral be x, 2x, 3x, and 4x.

x + 2x + 3x + 4x = 360 ⇒ 10x = 360.

x = 360 ÷ 10 = 36º.

questions.question: The ratio of boys to girls in a school is 7:5. If 20 more girls join the school, the new ratio of boys to girls becomes 7:6. What is the total number of students in the school initially?
questions.questionHtml: The ratio of boys to girls in a school is 7:5. If 20 more girls join the school, the new ratio of boys to girls becomes 7:6. What is the total number of students in the school initially?
questions.solution:
Let boys = 7k and girls = 5k.

⇒ After 20 girls join, new girls = 5k + 20.

⇒ New ratio = 7 : 6 ⇒ 7k ÷ (5k + 20) = 7 ÷ 6.

⇒ Cross multiply: 7k × 6 = 7 × (5k + 20).

⇒ 42k = 35k + 140 ⇒ 42k − 35k = 140 ⇒ 7k = 140 ⇒ k = 20.

⇒ Boys = 7 × 20 = 140; Girls = 5 × 20 = 100.

⇒ Total students initially = 140 + 100 = 240.
